title: Built a game to ease the pain of forgetting how to read code.
author: DrippyCorn
selftext:
I use AI coding agents daily, and somewhere along the way I realized I was barely reading what they wrote anymore.

So I rounded up all the homies in Pi and built a game around it.

It’s called [LPM Code](https://lpmcode.dev), a free browser-based coding RPG where you play as a developer surviving a week at a fictional startup.

You type code, build projects, deal with production incidents, and review AI-generated code that \*might\* contain bugs. There’s even a rubber duck that quizzes you on whether you understand what you just wrote.

Basically a typing game meets code review meets corporate suffering.

Built it for fun, but also because I genuinely think AI coding tools are making it way too easy to lose touch with the fundamentals.

\*\*Play free, no signup:\*\* [https://lpmcode.dev](https://lpmcode.dev)

Would love some feedback!
